about: Per-chip capability table for the check core: which dtypes a chip can honestly test. testable=false is a VISIBLE SKIP (blogs/notes/ch01-design-2026-10-09.md, 'matrix'). Measured live; evidence in blogs/notes/evidence/image-2026-10-09/.

fp64.notes: reference only: matmul 43x slower than fp32 here (0.16 vs 6.9 TFLOP/s)

fp32.notes: TF32 off by default (allow_tf32=False) and sm_75 has no TF32 anyway

fp16.notes: tensor cores; 39.6 TFLOP/s matmul; layer_norm/gelu/softmax/sdpa(causal) kernels run

bf16.skip_reason: sm_75 has no bf16 hardware: torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported(including_emulation=False) is False; bf16 runs only emulated (matmul 3.8 TFLOP/s, slower than fp32), so it does not test the bf16 kernels a bf16 chip (sm_80+) would run
